bundle.shortDescription: A Minecraft client that doesn't get in your way.
bundle.longDescription: Breeze Client is a Minecraft launcher with cloud-synced capes and cosmetics, Fabric mod support, and Microsoft sign-in. Java is set up for you, your mods come across from other launchers, and everything stays where you expect it.
